--approve.help: Set to false if you do not want to approve.

--caKey.help: The CA private key file path.

--client-ca-file.help: If set, enables mTLS by requiring and verifying client certificates signed by this CA.

--create.help: Create a release from the current commit

--dialPath.help: Path to health check gRPC service

--dir.help: Directory to place build metadata in

--endpoint.help: location of the unix domain socket the Kubelet communicates with the CSI plugin on

--expiry-days.help: The time (in days from today UTC) to expire the images (default: 90d)

--force-override.help: Set expiry even if the image has an expiry set already

--format.help: Output format, one of json, md.

--group-by-service.help: group frontends that share the same service ID and print their backends once per group

--host.help: Mark route as host: specify 'local' or 'remote'

--kubeconfig.help: Path to a kubeconfig. Only required if out-of-cluster.

--live.help: Check if the server is alive

--loglevel.help: Log level for the driver to report on

--master.help: The address of the Kubernetes API server. Overrides any value in kubeconfig. Only required if out-of-cluster.

--new-branch.help: Create a new release branch from master

--nexthop.help: Next hop IP for route (remote routes)

--nodeid.help: Node ID unique to the node

--port.help: Secure port that the webhook listens on

--pretty.help: Pretty-print the output (only applies to sem-change-in).

--publish.help: Publish the release built from the current tag

--raw.help: dump the raw conntrack table as is. For version < 3 it is always raw

--ready.help: Check if the server is ready

--relative-date.help: Set the expiry to days from last image modification instead

--restore.help: If the image tag is already expired, restore it to the last known tag

--sign.help: Set to false if you do not want to sign.

--status-file.help: File to write status information to

--tls-cert-file.help: File containing the default x509 Certificate for HTTPS. (CA cert, if any, concatenated after server cert).

--tls-private-key-file.help: File containing the default x509 private key matching --tls-cert-file.

--w.help: Write result to (source) file instead of stdout

--workload.help: Mark route as workload: specify 'local' or 'remote'

-app-id.help: Vault app-id to use with the app-id backend (only used with -backend=vault and auth-type=app-id)

-auth-type.help: Vault auth backend type to use (only used with -backend=vault)

-basic-auth.help: Use Basic Auth to authenticate (only used with -backend=etcd)

-log-level.help: level which confd should log messages

-password.help: the password to authenticate with (only used with vault and etcd backends)

-scheme.help: the backend URI scheme for nodes retrieved from DNS SRV records (http or https) (default "http")

-srv-domain.help: the name of the resource record

-srv-record.help: the SRV record to search for backends nodes. Example: _etcd-client._tcp.example.com

-table.help: the name of the DynamoDB table (only used with -backend=dynamodb)

-user-id.help: Vault user-id to use with the app-id backend (only used with -backend=value and auth-type=app-id)

-username.help: the username to authenticate as (only used with vault and etcd backends)

back.help: deletes a NAT backend for frontend id

image_names.help: The image to remove expiry from

maglev.help: dumps the maglev consistent-hash backend table

set.help: sets an entry in the NAT tables

write.help: Writes a key-value pair, each encoded in base64
